CLAIMED bd-627z.4 (deterministic agent->identity binding + clear assign errors). Reserved: flywheel/src/{main,state,backend/agentmail}.rs.

SCOPE: numbered agents (oc2/oc3/oc4) resolve to SHIFTING adjective+noun identities across assign calls. Spawn registry already persists pane->name; extend it to bind pane/name -> MAIL identity deterministically.

PLAN:
1. state.rs: SpawnEntry gains mail_identity (Option<String>, serde default) — recorded at spawn (register_spawned_agent).
2. main.rs: resolve_mail_target / cmd_assign resolve THROUGH the registry map (same agent, same identity every call); fall back to hash-mapping only when no registry entry.
3. cmd_assign: resolution failure names agent + expected identity + fix (never bare unknown recipient).
4. Tests: registry roundtrip survives reload (daemon-restart equivalent); two resolves of the same agent -> same identity; unknown agent -> actionable error.
